text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I go to visit Silence Suzuka in the prep
room
before the race only to discover
she isn't there.

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
I got the itch, so I did a lap around the

racecourse.

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: It looks like it's about time...

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
I'll give everything I have to reach the
front...

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: I won't give up the lead to anyone.
